title: Gen Alpha Villagers
description: This Resource Pack makes Villagers hold a Tablet!
body:
**THIS PACK REQUIRES OPTIFINE**

This Resource Pack gives Villagers Tablets!

This is a goofy brainrot Resource Pack that took inspiration from Gen Alpha/Beta which is being GLUED to there screens

For LEGAL reasons if you think the back of tablet looks like an iPad well it's not an iPad

AND this pack is NOT compatible with any packs that alter villagers.

Hope y'all enjoy my goofy resource pack!
